bracketing_exemplars: Ohio RB 2026 (20, this round - returning FBS volume beats imported FCS volume)
rationale_bullets: Trayanum (1,015 yds; 76.7/182) and Christian (528; portal->None, print-confirmed gone) take ~90% of 2025 carries out.
CJ Miller (Mercer: 957 rush, 1st-Tm SoCon, 1,267 scrimmage/17 TD) arrives WITH his entire offensive staff - the strongest form of the FCS-import case (in-scheme, zero install cost).
Depth is real bodies: Walendzak (ret; led team rushing '23), Ison (Mercer, in-scheme), C.Smith (PSU, 14 B10 att), Drennen (ex-UK).
16 = Buffalo RB tier; above SacSt/EMU 14 (Miller healthy + in-scheme vs Curtis's injury cloud), below Ohio 20 (returning FBS volume).

rationale_bullets: Top three WRs + TE1 all gone (Vandeross 81.3/386, Rudolph, Holley, Petersen) + Ezirim (WKU, praised by opposing coach) + Crosby (research-GONE) + five more receivers to UConn.
Replacements are FCS/D2 producers: Dabbs (Mercer 856 @ 19.0, in-scheme), Bond (Lindenwood 701, Jerry Rice finalist), Gilbert (SEMO); Simpson's ~950-yd FBS season is from 2023 (3 routes since).
